## Assemble only the branches you mean

A `CircuitPlan` records physical topology; it does not solve it. Built-in
factories live on the immutable `components` catalog and every physical value
uses the shared unit registry. This is the smallest concrete example of the
[Plan as physical authority](../../docs/concepts/physical-authority-and-reusable-composition.qmd#plan-as-physical-authority).

```{python}
#| id: author-primitive-circuit
from scnsim import CircuitPlan, components, units as u

plan = CircuitPlan(id="primitive_resonator")
coupling_cap = plan.add(
    components.capacitor(id="coupling_cap", capacitance=6.0 * u.fF)
)
resonator_cap = plan.add(
    components.capacitor(id="resonator_cap", capacitance=110.0 * u.fF)
)
resonator_ind = plan.add(
    components.inductor(id="resonator_ind", inductance=5.8 * u.nH)
)

signal_boundary = plan.net(coupling_cap.pin("terminal_1"))
resonator_node = plan.net(
    coupling_cap.pin("terminal_2"),
    resonator_cap.pin("terminal_1"),
    resonator_ind.pin("terminal_1"),
    id="resonator_node",
)
plan.ground(
    resonator_cap.pin("terminal_2"),
    resonator_ind.pin("terminal_2"),
)
signal_port = plan.add_port(
    id="signal_in",
    at=signal_boundary,
    role="terminated",
    reference_impedance=50.0 * u.ohm,
)
```

Keep the returned component, node, and Port handles. Later requests can refer
to the exact authored objects without replacing their identities with strings.

## Inspect before analysis

`render_schematic()` projects the authored circuit; it neither seals nor
solves the Plan. `CircuitDiagramSpec` selects an authoring or compiled
representation and presentation details. Here the diagram should show one
50-ohm boundary, one coupling capacitor, and parallel C/L branches sharing one
local ground bus.

```{python}
#| id: show-authoring-schematic
from scnsim import CircuitDiagramSpec

diagram = plan.render_schematic(
    CircuitDiagramSpec(show_parameter_values=True)
)
diagram.show()
```

The dev3 candidate returns a real Schemdraw authoring diagram here. It remains
presentation of the authored Plan—not numerical evidence and not a solver run.
